about_the_game:
Freaky Dreams is a survivor-like game where you open your eyes only to find yourself trapped in a nightmare from which you cannot wake. Surrounded by strange and twisted creatures, you must strike deals with demons to gain strength and devour grotesque monsters. Only by surviving can you discover whether this is a real nightmare or a nightmarish reality.

Game Features

  • Unique hand-drawn artwork depicting a mad, nightmare world

  • Face off against bizarre creatures while wearing your ordinary pajamas

  • Devour different monsters to gain power, absorbing their limbs to evolve into insane attack forms

  • Choose carefully when cleansing your soul—the higher the price, the greater the reward

  • Each failure will fracture your soul, and only by discerning the patterns of the dream can you rise again

  • Even the seemingly endless nightmare has an end. Break through the layers of mist and unveil the true nature of the dream

  • Dodge bullet-hell attacks and use your skill to defeat powerful bosses
